Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 1998
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE III OF 1998
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Local Government
Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1998]
No. S. Legis: 1(3)/98, dated
13-3-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local
Government (Amendment) Ordinance. 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Ordinance (No.XII of 1979)

ORDINANCE III OF 1998
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE III OF 1998
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Local Government
Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1998]
No. S. Legis: 1(3)/98, dated
13-3-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Sindh Ordinance (No.XII of 1979).--In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance,
1979, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3:--
(i) in clause (14), in sub-clause
(c), for the words "a union council or deh panchayat", the words
"or a union council" shall be substituted;
(ii) in clause (15), for the
words "union council or deh panchayat", the words "union
council" shall be substituted;
(iii) clauses (17-A) and (18-A)
shall be deleted;
(iv) in clause (47) between the
article 'a' and the word 'mohallah', the words 'village or' shall be inserted;
(v) in clause (63), the words
"or a deh panchayat" shall be deleted.

6. Amendment of section 37-A

in subsection (1), for the proviso, the following shall be substituted:
"Provided that no person
contesting an election shall be disqualified from contesting election by reason
only of his being a member of a political party.".
